title: Low oil level warning, 10 August 2020

ground_truth.note: the oil-level input reads low for long stretches of August; the rule behind W116 fires and the question is whether the pipeline explains it as an oil-level cause rather than as a leak

notes: W116 is the one controller message the default lead-time comparison leaves out, because it is a maintenance state rather than a fault the data turns on. This scenario is where it is looked at on purpose, so the code is named here explicitly. Reported, never gated.
